youtube.description:
Manhole ke dhakkan gol hote hain, aur iske peeche ek bahut smart wajah hai. Agar dhakkan square hota, to usse side se ghumakar uske hi hole ke andar diagonally girाया ja sakta tha, kyunki square ke corners ke beech ki doori uski sides ke beech ki doori se zyada hoti hai.

Circle har direction mein same width ka hota hai, isliye wo kabhi andar nahi gir sakta. Ye dhakkan bhaari bhi hote hain, aksar sau pound se zyada ke cast iron ke, aur neeche kaam kar rahe worker ko chot pahunch sakti hai. Gol dhakkan ko roll karna bhi aasaan hai, aur use wapas lagate waqt line up karne ki zaroorat nahi padti.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
